name: Etapp 31: Skokloster slott to Sånka camping

description.long: Final numbered main etapp in the public Upplandsleden set; continues from Etapp 30 at Skokloster and ends at Sånka on the west side of Skohalvön.

utilities: Mapped facilities on this section include heritage, attraction, campsite, swimming, water, toilet, food, parking, transit, rule warning.
waterSources: Use listed water rows as planning-grade refill information; seasonal access, non-potable warnings, and local signage override static data.
notes: Final numbered main etapp in the public Upplandsleden set; continues from Etapp 30 at Skokloster and ends at Sånka on the west side of Skohalvön.
Use Naturkartan Etapp 31 GPX as primary geometry.
No numbered Etapp 32 found in current public sources; do not fabricate onward numbered-stage handoff.
Treat Sånka services as endpoint cluster and keep Skoklosterslingan 31:1 loop features separate.
